definitions.gloss: carbonated water; sparkling water; soda water
definitions.explanation: Water that has been infused with carbon dioxide gas, creating bubbles. Widely available in Japan as a drink on its own or as a mixer.

examples.japanese: {炭酸水|たんさんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{炭酸水|たんさんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{売|う}れている→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: Sparkling water has been selling well lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦ウイスキー→ウイスキー：00412_uisukii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{炭酸水|たんさんすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ハイボール→ハイボール：27604_haibooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you mix whiskey with sparkling water, you get a highball.

notes:
USAGE:
A common everyday word. {炭酸水|たんさんすい} specifically refers to plain carbonated water without flavoring. Flavored carbonated drinks are called ⟦{炭酸飲料|たんさんいんりょう}→炭酸飲料：19494_tansaninryou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭酸水|たんさんすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧ (to mix with sparkling water)
- ⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧{炭酸水|たんさんすい} (unsweetened sparkling water)
- {強|つよ}⟦{炭酸|たんさん}→炭酸：13376_tansan⟧ (strong carbonation)

FORMS:
⟦{炭酸|たんさん}→炭酸：13376_tansan⟧ (carbonic acid) + {水|すい} (water).
